claims.text: The hotel is in Berlin City West, by the Kurfürstendamm shopping district.

findings.quote: Located in the heart of the prestigious neighbourhoods of Berlin City West, by the luxury shopping district of Kurfürstendamm

claims.text: The Berlin Zoo and Tiergarten park are just across the street from the hotel.

findings.quote: major attractions—including the Berlin Zoo and Tiergarten park—are just across the street

claims.text: The hotel is set in a skyscraper in City West.

findings.quote: set in an elegant skyscraper in City West

claims.text: It is the sole Waldorf Astoria in Germany.

findings.quote: It’s the only Waldorf Astoria in Germany.

claims.text: ROCA blends Italian cuisine with the urban spirit of New York.

findings.quote: ROCA blends Italian soul with the urban spirit of New York.
ROCA, a modern tribute to Italian Soul Food with subtle New York vibes

claims.text: ROCA has a hand-painted ceiling mural.

findings.quote: highlighted by a flamboyant hand-painted ceiling mural

claims.text: The Lang Bar has Art Deco surroundings and serves Film Noir-inspired drinks.

findings.quote: Sit back and relax in the lush Art Deco surroundings while you enjoy one of many Film Noir-inspired drinks

claims.text: The Library Lounge on the 15th floor serves afternoon tea with views across the city.

findings.quote: enjoying afternoon tea with views across the city from the 15th-floor Library Lounge

claims.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa is on the fifth floor.

findings.quote: The 1,000 sqm spa is located on the fifth floor

claims.text: All rooms and suites feature a marble bathroom, Nespresso coffee machine, dining table and safe.

findings.quote: All rooms and suites feature a marble bathroom, Nespresso coffee machine, TV, dining table, WiFi access and safe.

claims.text: Tower Suites on the upper floors have a kitchenette and access to the tower lift.

findings.quote: On the upper floors (22 to 29), the King Tower Suites offer a private living area, a kitchenette and access to the tower lift.
On the upper floors (24 to 29), the Premier King Tower Suites offer a separate living area, a kitchenette, and access to the tower lift.

claims.text: The Family Deluxe Room combines a King Deluxe and an adjoining Twin Deluxe Room and sleeps two adults and two children.

findings.quote: Comprised of a King Deluxe and adjoining Twin Deluxe Room. Sleeps two adults and two children.

claims.text: Peacock Alley is named after a corridor that connected the original Waldorf Hotel to the Astoria in New York.

findings.quote: Named after a grand corridor connecting the original Waldorf Hotel to its sister, the Astoria, in New York

claims.text: Rooms have a dining table for private dining, a nod to Waldorf Astoria, where room service is said to have been invented.

findings.quote: In keeping with the history of Waldorf Astoria, where room service is said to have been invented, a comfortable dining table for two is available for private fine dining.

claims.text: The spa has a cloud-shaped pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, five therapy rooms and a terrace.

findings.quote: includes five therapy rooms, a cloud-shaped pool, Finnish sauna, steam room, terrace

claims.text: The Lang Bar channels the film director Fritz Lang.

findings.quote: Channeling the legendary film director Fritz Lang, the Lang Bar sports a cool Art Deco vibe

claims.text: The Champagne and Eggs all-day breakfast serves Waldorf Astoria inventions such as Eggs Benedict.

findings.quote: the all-day ‘Champagne and Eggs’ feast
Waldorf Astoria inventions such as Eggs Benedict are served

claims.text: Spa access costs hotel guests 15 euros per person per day; it is complimentary for Tower Suite guests and Hilton Honors Silver, Gold and Diamond members.

findings.quote: Access to the Waldorf Astoria Spa is available to hotel guests for a fee of €15 per person, per day.
Spa access is complimentary for guests staying in our Tower Suites and for Hilton Honors Silver, Gold and Diamond members.

claims.text: Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult in the spa.

findings.quote: Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
